title: New Single Release:
subtitle: I Am A Planet / Sleepyhead
content:
I am thrilled to report our new single "I Am a Planet / Sleepyhead" is now available on Bandcamp, Soundcloud and everywhere music is streamed. The two new songs were recorded last month at my home studio. I think they represent our finest work to date. Please give it a listen and may one listen lead to many more.

- Miles

title: 2019 Northeast Tour 9/25 - 8/2
content:
The Road To Ruin are over the moon to announce we will be putting out a new single and embarking on an east coast tour at the end of the month. We will be traveling 8 days and will play shows in Portland ME, Providence RI, Somerville MA, Brooklyn NY and Philadelphia PA. To celebrate this, our first tour, we have recorded a studio version of our live staple I Am A Planet and a brand new song called Sleepyhead.

9/25 - Portland Empire, ME
9/27 - Fosket and Friends, MA
9/28 - Flipp Salon, RI
9/29 - News Cafe, RI
9/30 - The Well, Brooklyn
10/2 - Bourbon and Branch, PA

title: 10/17/17 -- The Road To Ruin's Rock N' Roll Circus @ Gold Sounds!
subtitle: 7:30 Doors / 8pm Show
content:
The Road To Ruin are honored to be playing at Gold Sounds for the first time ever! We are so excited to bring the circus alongside some of our favorite friends, Ick, Cryochild, and I'm Not Holden Caulfield -- be sure to check each of them out as they are all awesome and a joy to behold!

Come rock out with us!

title: Upcoming Show: 10/5/17 @ The Side Walk Cafe, 9:30 PM
content: The Road To Ruin return to the Sidewalk Cafe! You can expect most of the set to be new and unreleased material from the upcoming album. Come sneak a peek at what's to come!

title: Upcoming Show: 6/22/17 @ Muchmore's, Time TBD
content: We're gearing up for a night of tunes with the incredible rock duo, Ick! This will be The Road to Ruin's first show at Muchmore's (more details coming soon!) and we are so grateful to Ick for bringing us on for this show. They're a killer act, I can't wait to see them and the same should go for you! We've got a tight set for this show and we're really looking forward to playing for some new faces -- Come show yours!

title: Upcoming Show: 6/17/17 @ Little Skips, 9:30PM
content: Come through and share a night of music and drink with us at Little Skips! Little Skips is an awesome venue and we're so excited and honored to be playing there again. If you have never seen us before, it is time we changed that -- you won't regret it. And to our new found die-hard fans out there: we can't wait to hear you sing along with us on the ones you know and to give you something new to gnaw on for the ones you don't!

title: Upcoming Show: 5/4/17 @ The Sidewalk Cafe, 10PM
content: Join us for an evening of driving tunes at the Sidewalk Cafe! We have a new addition to the line-up, Mike Sposato, a rippin' lead guitarist who we are so happy to bring on stage. Even if you have seen us before, given Mike's added presence and the new unreleased tracks we're planning to play, you won't want to miss this one! See you there!

title: New Album -- Heartbeat From the Next Step
subtitle: Full Release!
content: Heartbeat From The Next Step, the new album, is now streaming on Soundcloud!!!!!!!!! God we've waited a long time to say that. Please, everyone, give it a listen, we put a lot of time into making it and we promise the time you spend listening will be absolutely worth it. Thanks so much to Erik Sandfort, Andy Freeman, Rob Fragnito, Dave Kahn, Mike Haldeman, Zack Handler, Coby Ketner Unger and so many others for helping to make this happen, we are so proud!!!!!!! Get ready Little Skips! We're coming for you tomorrow night!!!!!!!!!!!!
